name: Balancer V2
description: Balancer is a protocol for programmable liquidity.
hallmarks: Balancer pausable pools move to withdrawals-only
Most Balancer pools become withdrawals-only, bug bounty ends; users advised to exit.

hacks.name: Balancer V2
hacks.description: Balancer V2's boosted pools suffered a $893k-$979k exploit on August 27, 2023 via rate manipulation in linear pools (ERC4626). The attacker manipulated token conversion rates to drain liquidity.

hacks.name: Balancer V2
hacks.description: On November 3, 2025, Balancer V2's Composable Stable Pools were exploited for $128M via a rounding-down flaw in batchSwap invariant calculation. Minuscule discrepancies in each transaction compounded across rapid successive swaps, gradually deflating pool reserves across chains.

hacks.name: Balancer V2
hacks.description: Balancer's DNS was hijacked and redirected users to phishing frontend, stealing ~$238K from users. Smart contracts were unaffected; only DNS infrastructure was compromised.
